title: Effigy
description: Inspired by Gargoyles. New entities are found across the land for Spooky Season!
body:
A mod made for SpookyJam 2025. Happy Halloween!

Join the [Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/xHRwb8mPKB)! 



This mod adds:

- 2 Entities
- 2 Structures
- A couple of Items and Blocks!

Entities

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Grotesque: A mob found on the new Structures! In the daytime they are almost indestructible, and at night they become alive!

</details>


Items

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gravekeeper's Wet Stone: An item found at the Mausoleum in a Grotesque Graveyard.
- Water Jet: Crafted with the Gravekeeper's Wet Stone, the Boss drop, and stone. Needs a Water Bottle to function. Contains a new enchantment!

</details>


Blocks

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Grotesque Head: Crafted with Stone in a StoneCutter, can be used to summon a Grotesque in its place!
- Reassembling Stones: Can be created by using the Boss drop on Cobblestone. Grotesques on this block can protect rows of it!

</details>


Boss

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gargoyle: It is found in the Gargoyle Crypt. It will be found in pieces, just interact with it, and the boss fight will start! It protects the area around it, not letting players build or place.
![Gargoyle In Pieces](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56637eacd55e258a1a0d50a63a4ce1669b34c677.png)

![Gargoyle After Interacted](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93426b9b8ebcaa9714563db73b5c7e98996fec0f.png)

- The Gargoyle Drops the Gargoyle Charm, it can be used on the Grotesque Head and Cobblestone. It will lose durability on use, but Mending can be applied! The charm also not not break when it loses all durability.

</details>
